name: Kanojo, Amai Kanojo
source:
We made love. I came inside her.

She asked, knowing I'm quick to run away,
"Would you abandon me?"

I went to a boys school, she went to a girl's school.
Being in love for the first time was the tenderest taste in the world,
a lemon infused with sugar and sugar, and sugar again.

If I was able to be with her,
we could live just on the sweetness.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE162097.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我们做爱了。我射在了她体内。

她明知我很快就会逃走，却问道：
“你会抛弃我吗？”

我上的是男子学校，她上的是女子学校。
第一次恋爱的滋味是世上最温柔的味道，
像柠檬里混入糖，再混入糖，最后又混入糖。

如果我能和她在一起，
我们或许只靠这份甜蜜就能生活下去。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE162097.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
